methods.mother: Only unchanged-topology mother NPZ central/ear-body arrays receive exact corresponding-vertex checks.
methods.print: Independent topology. Actual v8 visible exterior vertex samples to nearest v9 surface, with normal disagreement reported separately. No ray fallback is substituted for a nearest-distance value: this can jump to a distant ear fold. Reverse samples must be within0.65mm of current mother with aligned normal (dot>=0.25), belong to its actual central/ear source region, then receive barycentric v8 region membership within2mm; this prevents adjacent newly modeled cranium being mislabeled as ear.
methods.statistics: Full selected baseline vertices; reverse current vertices within regional bounds. Means/percentiles are vertex-sampling weighted. Maxima are sampled distances, not certified continuous Hausdorff bounds.
methods.raw: Original PMX ROI vertices to full mother/print surfaces, v8 and v9. Nearest-distance change is distinct from a corresponding-vertex displacement.
methods.ear_442: The 442-point v7 finished PRINT ear-back patch is tracked separately from the coincidentally 442-point v5 MOTHER ear-root strip. Different meshes, masks and meanings.
methods.upper_cranium: Source-origin high forehead and added cranium are intentionally reconstructable; no blanket original-material zero constraint or upper-forehead displacement cap is added by this audit.

scope: Measurement report, not a zero-change claim for remeshed PRINT, a dimensional acceptance threshold, eye-aperture contour test, thickness test or physical fit certification. STL hash is bound to this report; exact STL correspondence is handled by the independent structure/export validation.

earback_actual_mesh_visual_review.method: Two close orthographic views of actual delivered PRINT meshes under identical neutral material, camera and lighting. No model saved or geometry changed.
earback_actual_mesh_visual_review.observed: The rebuilt ear-to-head groove is more exposed along the back of the ear. The locally large reverse nearest-surface distance is a real difference in this exposed attachment surface; it is not evidence of corresponding-vertex movement.
earback_actual_mesh_visual_review.remaining_surface_detail: Small pre-existing ear-edge irregularities remain. Shallow undulations above the attachment are more apparent than v8 under this close side-lighting; this is not a claim that the ear surface is perfectly smooth.
earback_actual_mesh_visual_review.decision_scope: No central-face projection recommended. Do not claim exact preservation of the old finished PRINT ear surface. Retain measured differences transparently; do not project the new ear-back groove into the old cranial envelope solely to reduce the distance statistic.
earback_actual_mesh_visual_review.scope_limit: Visual inspection of the two rendered views; independent mesh validation covers topology and intersections.
